Resolves #6032

Changes `Neo.button.Base#editRoute` default value from `true` to `false` in `src/button/Base.mjs` so `route` buttons render anchor tags (`<a href="#...">`) by default, updates the 6 parameterized `mainview=...` tab `header` configs in `apps/covid/view/MainContainer.mjs` and `apps/sharedcovid/view/MainContainer.mjs` with explicit `editRoute: true`, and removes redundant `editRoute: false` overrides in `src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs`, `apps/portal/Overwrites.mjs`, `examples/serverside/toolbarItems/Overwrites.mjs`, and `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit spec `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` verifying `editRoute: false` default anchor rendering and `editRoute: true` `<button>` + `Neo.Main.editRoute` dispatch) → L2 required (#6032).
